1) In `cart.parse_coupon`, coupon codes are case-sensitive; spec requires case-insensitive matching.
2) The `Cart.total` method incorrectly calculates shipping fee based on the original subtotal instead of the discounted amount (after applying a coupon). This leads to free shipping when the original subtotal exceeds the threshold, even if the discounted subtotal would incur shipping. These differences violate the module’s specification.
